correctness.rationale: Complete analytic reconstruction: A±B has two squared singular values with sum a²+b²±2ab Re(inner-product pair) and product a²b²(1-c²)(1-d²). For 0<p<1, the p/2-power sum strictly increases in both sum and product; cd≤(c²+d²)/2 gives an achieved fixed-Q maximum at positive projections. Their positive eigenvalues are (a+b±sqrt((a-b)²+2abQ))/2. A Stieltjes integral proves strict decrease and concavity of F(Q); derivative at Q=0 gives K, and tangent convexity yields the sharp global stability coefficient, with projection sharpness. Endpoint Q=0,2 and a=b limits addressed. Standalone two-by-two numerical cross-checks passed, but theorem rests on proof.
